headline: Florida and Georgia face off in historic Atlanta college football clash
standfirst: The No. 3 Georgia Bulldogs play the No. 17 Florida Gators at Mercedes-Benz Stadium, marking a historic venue change for the classic rivalry.
keyPoints: The Florida Gators meet the Georgia Bulldogs at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta.
The traditional venue in Jacksonville is undergoing renovations.
The game is broadcast nationally on ABC with streaming options available.
Georgia enters with a 6-1 record while Florida holds a 5-2 standing.

paragraphs: The No. 3 Georgia Bulldogs and the No. 17 Florida Gators meet on Saturday for their annual Southeastern Conference football showdown. This year's game takes place at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta, Georgia. Fans across the country can watch the national broadcast on ABC or access various online streaming alternatives.

The traditional home of this long-running series has been EverBank Stadium in Jacksonville, Florida, where the teams have played since 1933. However, ongoing renovations at the Jacksonville facility forced the relocation of the fixture for the first time in history. The high-profile encounter brings together two prominent collegiate programs seeking to dominate the league standings.

sections.heading: Rivalry history and venue relocation
paragraphs: The fixture represents one of the most enduring traditions in collegiate athletics, pitting two regional powerhouses against each other. Moving the contest to Atlanta introduces a novel dynamic for players and fans accustomed to the Florida coastal setting. Organisers anticipate a strong turnout inside the modern dome stadium for the historic ninth-week game.

The venue shift also offers a different travel experience for the respective fanbases, who usually congregate in Jacksonville for the autumn weekend. Local businesses in Atlanta prepare for an influx of visitors attending the weekend sporting event and associated festivities. Past iterations of the classic rivalry have frequently drawn notable celebrity sightings from the entertainment industry.

sections.heading: Team standings and current form
paragraphs: The Georgia Bulldogs enter the weekend with a six-win and one-loss record following a recent recovery period. Their momentum was briefly interrupted by an unexpected defeat against the Auburn Tigers two weeks prior. Despite playing in their home state, the team aims to rebound and secure a crucial conference victory.

The Florida Gators arrive in Georgia holding a five-win and two-loss record for the current campaign. They gained significant confidence from a recent upset victory over the Texas Longhorns. Observers note that Florida approaches the contest as underdogs while striving to maintain their upward trajectory.
